raised: The page never says what banks actually pay today, so the reader can't tell if the 1.8% example rate is realistic
The calculator shows less money left (68,270) than was deposited (70,000), and the reader had to work out for themselves that inflation was the reason
The '123 מקור / 123 מחושב / 123 הזנתי' line under the title is confusing
The second paragraph of 'מה זה' (8 deposit types, 'אפשרות השבירה ותחנות היציאה') went over the reader's head
The 'צמוד למדד' paragraph only made sense after a second reading
The term 'עוגן' and the anchor-rate line naming the banks were confusing
The note says an entered rate shows as a dashed line, but the reader couldn't find one
The 'תקופה 12 חודשים' text is cut off
The reader didn't understand why the example adds ₪500 a month to a deposit
The comparison with 'קרן כספית' lost the reader
The codes (TXI-03, BANK-06, etc.) and the green code tags meant nothing
'אין ביטוח פיקדונות' is worrying, and the reader doesn't know how worried to be
'חשבון במערכת סגורה' makes opening a deposit at another bank sound complicated
The 'כמה זה עולה' table doesn't say how much anything costs
The 'הפסד ממכירת ניירות ערך' paragraph wasn't understood
The red box admits the site doesn't know how tax treats a broken deposit
The bank-collapse warning is scary, and the reader wants more information
The thin pinkish line on the chart is unexplained
The dotted purple underline on the result lines makes it unclear whether they can be clicked
The 'חוקים וכללים' column in the cost table is empty
The glossary's 'איפה מופיע' column and its tags meant nothing
Terms like 'מוצרי שוק הכסף', 'מערכת סגורה' and 'הבטחת קרן' weren't understood
The line 'הריבית שבבנק פרסם; ריבית שתזינו תחול על כל היתרה' wasn't understood
No example in shekels of what breaking the deposit early costs
No comparison with leaving the money in a current account or with the S&P 500
Can't find a minimum amount or how to actually open a deposit
No guidance on whether a fixed or variable rate suits the reader
Would remove the long glossary, 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון', and the 'פטור למעוט הכנסה' paragraph
'מי מציע ומי מפקח' and 'כמה זה עולה' said almost nothing
